caseAssertions.scope: Source trace plus four passing Shop-path unit cases with outgoing API wrapper mocked. No actual Shopify redirect or persistence execution.
caseAssertions.observation: Current frontend intentionally ignores consent selection only when a Shop submission resumes from redirect. This omits open/click tracking decisions and avoids writing a false tracking refusal from the re-seeded empty block. It retains legacy marketing SUBSCRIBED unless the separate legacy opt_in_promotional_email flag is false. This documents the unresolved unchecked-marketing behavior; it is not a claim that marketing choice is preserved. Existing resume, popup, separate-phone-list and non-Shop restored-form unit cases all pass.
